test_nccl_is_available: test if NCCL is available and tensors are valid for distributed operations
run_nccl_all_reduce: run an NCCL all-reduce operation on a sequence of CUDA tensors with a reduction operator
run_nccl_reduce: run an NCCL reduce operation that gathers tensors to a root rank across devices
run_nccl_broadcast: run an NCCL broadcast operation to copy tensors from a root rank to all others
run_nccl_all_gather: run an NCCL all-gather operation to collect tensors from all ranks into a single output list
